## Experience

- **Founding Machine Learning Engineer — dCortex** (Full-time, May 2026 – Sep 2026)
  - Cut last-minute coverage scrambles ~40% by building a live 72-hour risk model that scores 8,000+ crew-duty pairs per window in under 100ms.
  - Cut override diagnosis ~70%, from a full-slate review to seconds, by building counterfactual analysis across 400+ live decisions.
  - Built a chat agent that writes and runs SQL so controllers can fetch crew identity, reserve status, and legality details in plain language, cutting lookup time ~80%.
- **Machine Learning Engineer — Bonsai Lab, RIT** (Research, Aug 2025 – Apr 2026)
  - Cut experiment iteration time by 60% with a modular PyTorch self-supervised learning pipeline for rapid representation comparisons.
  - Optimized data loading with pre-fetching and caching, raising GPU utilization and shortening training time.
  - Added automated experiment tracking and artifact versioning so distributed runs stay reproducible.
- **MLOps Engineer Intern — Incribo** (Internship, Jan 2024 – Jul 2024)
  - Designed and deployed a fault-tolerant microservices architecture for multi-agent AI systems on Kubernetes and Docker with RabbitMQ.
  - Cut GPU memory use by 15% and improved inference latency by serving LLMs with gradient checkpointing and dynamic batching.
  - Built a Go CLI to automate container orchestration and deployment.
  - Integrated synthetic data generation with CPPN-NEAT neuroevolution (+15% generation rate).

## Featured Projects

- **Asclepius** — https://asclepius.avinash.social (Code: https://github.com/droidmaximus/asclepius)
  - Stack: React, TanStack Start, Tailwind, Cytoscape.js, Supabase, Python, Selenium
  - AI atlas for rare diseases: Selenium bots scrape disease catalogues, trial registries, papers, and patient-group sites and reconcile them into a 1,461-node, 2,372-edge knowledge graph with source-backed claims.
- **Crosstem** — https://pypi.org/project/crosstem/
  - Stack: Rust, Python, PyO3, PyPI
  - High-performance multilingual NLP stemming library with a Rust core and Python API (2.7–2.9x faster than Python fallback, 15x higher throughput than Porter).
- **Ledgerline** — https://github.com/droidmaximus/ledgerline
  - Stack: Go, Python, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
  - Event-driven, vectorless RAG engine for 200+ page financial filings using hierarchical tree navigation, WebSocket streaming (<3s latency), and an LLM-as-a-judge layer.
- **Topological Arbitrage Engine** — https://github.com/droidmaximus/topological-arbitrage
  - Stack: Python, Pandas, SciPy, Flask
  - Market-neutral statistical arbitrage strategy applying graph Laplacian diffusion to CAPM residuals across an 80-stock universe (42.5% annualized return, 1.99 Sharpe out-of-sample).
